deterministic_schedule: per epoch: hit active key; compile unique version of pressure key and verify one FIFO eviction; invalidate active backing between calls and verify one removal; execute alternate admitted bytes under advanced backing version and verify one successful compile/publication without eviction; repeat and verify hit; alternate original/changed bytes on successive epochs. Every 128 epochs clear and assert zero current resident entries/code/metadata plus all 16 arena slots, then refill. Every 512 epochs clear, drop the sole runtime/arena, reopen one runtime, execute after reopen with a bumped execution context, and refill. No more than one MAP_JIT arena is live.
limitations: Invalidation is a direct between-call cache API exercise; production owner notification, guest-write SMC, and active-code modification are not tested.
RSS is an auxiliary process-wide snapshot and cannot establish cache attribution or a leak-free result.
No guest faults, simultaneous arenas, SMP, or concurrent independent runtime is exercised.
parity_contract: Every dispatched case is checked against its interpreter oracle for all GPR state, RIP, masked flags, exit, instruction budget and retired instruction count. The two code versions have distinct interpreter results; a version is only dispatched after the previous backing was invalidated, and its first dispatch must compile/publish before the required next-call hit.
